description: Cross-format numeric data processing and IEEE 754 conformance auditing

data_sources.description: IEEE 754 double-precision values in little-endian binary. Starts with a 4-byte LE uint32 count N, followed by N 8-byte LE doubles.
Decimal float strings, one per line. Comment lines begin with #.

notes: Additional data sources may exist in other subdirectories under data/. Explore the project to identify all available inputs.
